Find consensus pathways across studies

Source: R/06_pathway.R
mx_pathway_consensus.Rd

Identifies pathways that are significantly enriched in the majority of individual studies, indicating robust cross-study signal.

Usage

mx_pathway_consensus(
  pathway_results,
  min_fraction = 0.5,
  padj_threshold = 0.05
)

Arguments

pathway_results

A list of data.frame objects from per-study enrichment analyses.

min_fraction

Numeric. Minimum fraction of studies in which a pathway must be significant. Default: 0.5.

padj_threshold

Numeric. Significance threshold per study. Default: 0.05.

Value

A data.frame of consensus pathways with columns pathway_id, pathway_name, n_significant_studies, fraction_studies.

See also

mx_pathway_meta, mx_pathway_dedup

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  consensus <- mx_pathway_consensus(pathway_results)
} # }
